association_evidence.supports: Apple’s 19 July 2000 announcement lists Graphite as an available color for the 500 MHz iMac DV Special Edition. This establishes Graphite iMac availability in the period; it does not establish the pictured unit’s exact model, manufacturing date, a 1999 first-introduction date or a Y2K aesthetic classification.

CARI’s retrospective Y2K aesthetic category includes blobby electronics among its examples of period visual language. This supplies category context; it is not Apple’s own movement identification or a source authenticating this particular Graphite iMac photograph.
